design_provenance.observation: algebraic zero-centering gives empty evidence neutrality but not the class-conditional null likelihood ratio of actual click-conditioned cosine distributions
design_provenance.development_scene0003: forbidden until every source gate passes

data_contract.calibration_examples: every unique positive click prototype from every class-conditionally supported fit object; deterministic final-prefix 4096 positive and 4096 negative primitive rows
data_contract.reason_negative_clicks_are_not_calibrati: the complement of one target object is heterogeneous and cannot be treated as one clicked instance class

mathematical_contract.slope_constraint: nonnegative, so higher click similarity never lowers same-instance likelihood
mathematical_contract.positive_click_aggregation: sum ell_c(s) over observations and channels
mathematical_contract.negative_click_aggregation: subtract ell_c(s) over observations and channels
mathematical_contract.aggregate_bias: exact zero and absent from the parameterization
mathematical_contract.empty_evidence: empty positive and negative sets sum to ell=0 and q=0.5 exactly
mathematical_contract.learned_null_midpoint: -intercept_c/softplus(raw_slope_c), global per channel inside each source-training fold

training_recipe.objective: mean over channels of prevalence-weighted stratified ordinary posterior BCE

source_validation.failure_action: stop without opening scene0003 or test312
